  two-reviewer "Releasable" hostile-reader review (ADR-179), a
  "one-click / anonymous" dispute promise (ADR-180 — the receiver is
  not operating; intake is e-mail, senders disclose their address),

  public, and pages whose URL or title embeds a personal handle

  sha256-pinned row in `docs/build/reports/copy-batches/batch-01.md`,
  `pending` until the operator confirms it verbatim at the batch
  sitting. Notice strings N-1…N-7 ship by pinned hash under the
  temporary allowance. The L2 publish leg refuses a pending sentence
  (new publish-side gate), so the production gate enforces B-2 in code.
- The operator's adopted positions this wave encodes: "Email, no time
  promises" (dispute intake); priority order privacy-harm/safety →
  factual corrections → everything else, no time commitment (WV-08);
  "Adopt disclosed posture (Recommended)" (single maintainer, no
  counsel); the WV-01 interim individual legal home (ADR-165, E2-04
  drafted wording pending batch confirmation).
